Please note that eligibility for each leaderboard will be determined based on your SVIP level as of the day before the leaderboard begins:
SVIP 4-8 can join the Premium Ranking where you can get better rewards!
SVIP 0-3 can join the Basic Ranking.

Weekly Top 10 will get rewards. And the rewards will be sent automatically.

The leaderboard will run for 4 rounds with the following schedule:

Round 1: July 1 – July 11
Round 2: July 12 – July 18
Round 3: July 19 – July 25
Round 4: July 26 – July 31 (ends at 18:00 UTC+2)

If you have any questions, please contact the NLNE official SVIP account below or apply for the SVIP exclusive service group in your SVIP portal.
